history.content: How many tickets were resolved each day? Provide the breakdown sorted chronologically in descending order (newest to oldest).

Between March 13 and March 17, ticket resolutions remained remarkably consistent, with a slight peak of 4 resolutions on March 13 before stabilizing at 3 per day for the remainder of the period.

| Date | Tickets Resolved |
| :--- | :--- |
| 2025-03-17 | 3 |
| 2025-03-16 | 3 |
| 2025-03-15 | 3 |
| 2025-03-14 | 3 |
| 2025-03-13 | 4 |
